fr:frontmatter.fr:title: Linear logic
fr:frontmatter.fr:meta: @article{GIRARD19871, title = {Linear logic}, author = {Jean-Yves Girard}, year = {1987}, doi = {https://doi.org/10.1016/0304-3975(87)90045-4}, url = {https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0304397587900454}, journal = {Theoretical Computer Science}, volume = {50}, number = {1}, pages = {1-101}, abstract = {The familiar connective of negation is broken into two operations: linear negation which is the purely negative part of negation and the modality “of course” which has the meaning of a reaffirmation.
